name: F2 Revamp
author: miguelvf3
description: A Driver Career that starts in the 2026 Formula 2 season: finish well to earn an F1 seat, while the best F2 drivers move up too. Its own tile and save slots; the stock 2026 career is unchanged.

options.label: Portuguese GP (Portimao)
options.description: Adds Portugal to the 2027 calendar. Needs the mod.portimao addon on. Choose before starting a career.

options.label: Turkish GP (Istanbul Park)
options.description: Adds Turkey to the 2027 calendar. Needs the track.istanbul_park addon on. Choose before starting a career.

saves.message: F2 Revamp careers won't load without it; the launcher keeps them in the save until it is back on.
